author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete 
GO:0005052 peroxisome matrix targeting signal-1 binding
GO:0005053 peroxisome matrix targeting signal-2 binding
GO:0033328 peroxisome membrane targeting sequence binding

and replace by their parent, "peroxisome targeting sequence binding" (renamed "peroxisome signal sequence receptor activity"). The reason for obsoletion is that these signal sequences are recognized by the same receptor, therefore the exact signal sequence is beyond the scope of GO. 

There are 45 annotations (including 5 extensions) , see https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LHANTf5go-4uprGd1eKqQa9WpEnY25pvwyKdwUFwPgw/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups:
AspGD | 2
ComplexPortal | 2
GeneDB | 1
SGD | 5
UniProt | 30
UniProt -extensions | 5

and one mapping: 
InterPro:IPR044536 Peroxisomal targeting signal 2 receptor > GO:peroxisome matrix targeting signal-2 binding ; GO:0005053 |  

These term are not in any subsets. You can comment on the ticket : https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31419

Thanks, Pascale
title: Obsoletion with replacement: children of peroxisome matrix targeting signal binding
